proxy.title: Network proxy
proxy.scope: Routes client HTTP(S) / WebSocket traffic: models, login token exchange, updates, downloads and the built-in browser. Direct when off.
proxy.systemHint: System mode follows system settings and PAC direct-connection rules.
proxy.hostHint: Hostname or IP only, without a scheme, path or credentials. Enclose IPv6 in brackets.
proxy.invalidHost: Enter a valid hostname or IP without a scheme, path, spaces or credentials.
proxy.invalidPort: Port must be an integer from 1 to 65535.
proxy.limits: Applying disconnects existing network connections. Local callbacks stay direct. SSH, tunnels, external browsers and external programs are not controlled. Authenticated proxies and system SOCKS4 are not supported.

language.title: Language
language.uiDesc: The language used for all text in the app
language.aiDesc: Tell the AI, on every turn, which language to reply in

personalization.promptDesc: Give the Agent extra instructions and context for every chat. This is appended after the default system prompt.
personalization.placeholder: For example: Always answer in Simplified Chinese; explain your plan before editing code.
personalization.promptHint: This text is used on every new Agent turn. Leave it empty to disable it.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeModeDesc: Follows macOS appearance when set to System

common.title: General
common.thinkingDesc: Falls back automatically if the model does not support the chosen level
common.permissionDesc: {{mode}}; used at launch, and can be switched temporarily above the composer
common.keepAwakeDesc: Prevents sleep while an agent is running; restores afterwards
common.notificationsDesc: Master switch; turning it off silences every notice below
common.notifyDoneDesc: A background chat settles its run
common.notifyErrorDesc: A background chat settles on an error — a retry that gave up, a refused request
common.notifyApprovalDesc: A background chat is parked on a confirmation or question only you can answer
common.notifyUpdateDesc: A new version has finished downloading
common.permissionRulesDesc: Tool calls you chose 「Always allow」 for skip confirmation; {{count}} in total

chat.title: Chat
chat.queueDesc: What happens if you send while a reply is generating
chat.interruptDesc: Whether interrupting waits for the current turn to end
chat.autoCompactDesc: Compact the conversation when context is nearly full
chat.collapseRunsDesc: Fold thinking and tool calls into a duration row, leaving only the final answer; expand to review the process

about.tagline: Desktop client for agent work, code, and cowork
about.missing: No bundled snapshot; defaults will be used
about.exportLogsDesc: Save main-process and UI logs as a zip, for troubleshooting
about.resetDesc: Restore appearance, chat and shortcut preferences to their defaults; conversations are untouched

subagents.title: Subagent workspace
subagents.desc: Manage the roles the main agent can delegate to. Each subagent can use its own model and reasoning effort.
subagents.fallback: An unset model follows the parent agent. Legacy templates without reasoning use Medium. If the parent model is unavailable, the default model is used.
subagents.modelDesc: Leave empty to follow the parent agent's model
subagents.thinkingDesc: Legacy templates without a value use Medium
subagents.modelAndThinkingDesc: Choose both in one selector; the model may follow the parent agent and reasoning defaults to Medium
subagents.formDesc: The name is the role the main agent passes to the subagent tool.
subagents.name: Name
subagents.nameHint: Letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens only
subagents.toolsHint: Choose which tools this subagent can use
subagents.removeDesc: Running delegations are unaffected, but this role will no longer be available afterwards.

shortcuts.sendOnEnterDesc: When off, send with the send shortcut; Enter inserts a newline
shortcuts.recordingHint: Backspace to clear · Esc to cancel

update.title: Updates
update.autoCheckDesc: Check for new versions every 10 minutes after launch
update.disabled: Dev builds do not check for updates
update.ready: {{version}} is ready; installing requires a restart
update.dialogNoNotes: No release notes were provided for this update.

archived.intro: Archiving only hides a chat from the sidebar; the transcript stays on disk. Deleting removes the session record as well and cannot be undone.
archived.emptyDesc: Hover a chat in the sidebar and click the archive icon, or right-click and choose Archive.
archived.confirmSingleDesc: “{{title}}” and all of its messages will be deleted from disk and cannot be recovered.
archived.confirmManyDesc: These {{count}} archived chats and all of their messages will be deleted from disk and cannot be recovered.
archived.deletePartial: {{failed}} chats could not be deleted and remain in the archive.{{detail}}
archived.deleteFailed: Delete failed; the chats remain in the archive.{{detail}}
archived.deleteUnavailable: Delete is unavailable. Restart the app and try again.

usage.title: Usage
usage.billedByProvider: Billed as reported by the provider

providers.gatewayIdentifyNone: No known panel found — the balance cannot be read for this endpoint
providers.gatewayCredentialDesc: The balance for “{{name}}” comes from the New API panel, which wants its own access token rather than the relay key.
providers.gatewayCredentialStored: Saved — enter a new token to replace it
providers.gatewayCredentialHintWhere: Find it under 个人设置 → 生成系统访问令牌 in the panel; the user ID is shown on the 个人设置 page. The token stays on this machine and is never sent to other clients.
providers.gatewayHint: This site speaks both Anthropic and OpenAI protocols, so pick either.
providers.fastvibeDescription: FastVibe provides comprehensive, affordable, and reliable model gateway services,
providers.apiFormatHint: Default protocol for this provider; individual models can override it in model details.
providers.keySaved: Saved — enter a new key to update
providers.noModelsAdd: No models yet — add some below
providers.ccSwitchDesc: Read providers with API keys from ~/.cc-switch into FastVibe. Keys are never shown in the UI.
providers.ccSwitchEmpty: Nothing to import. Custom providers with API keys in CC Switch are needed; official login entries are skipped.
providers.fetched: Fetched {{count}} models — tick the ones to add.
providers.pickNative: Pick a built-in provider, then paste its API key or sign in with your subscription.
providers.fillCustom: Fill in a name, URL and key.
providers.name: Name
providers.pulled: Fetched {{count}} models — tick the ones to add.
providers.unsupportedKey: This built-in provider does not support API keys
providers.needFields: Enter a name, Base URL and API key
providers.oauthExtraUsage: A subscription login does not draw on your plan limits — it is billed per token from extra usage, which must be enabled on the account first.
providers.oauthWaiting: Waiting for the browser to finish…
providers.oauthLinkHint: The authorization page was opened in your browser; click the address below if it did not appear.
providers.oauthDeviceHint: Open the address below in a browser and enter this code.
providers.oauthManualHint: Finishing in the browser continues on its own; if the browser cannot reach this machine, paste the final redirect URL above.
providers.oauthPasteHint: Paste the authorization code or redirect URL
providers.needKeyOrLogin: Paste an API key, or sign in with your subscription first
providers.keyOverridesOauth: A saved API key is used instead of the subscription; clear it to go back.

modelDetail.outputInvalid: Max output must be a positive integer
modelDetail.needEffort: Tick at least one reasoning level, or uncheck Reasoning
modelDetail.title: Model details
modelDetail.traitsHint: Reasoning and image input are written to the engine config; video and files are recorded only.
modelDetail.thinkingHint: After ticking Reasoning you can choose a level; leaving it off means this model sends no thinking parameter.

mcp.dialogDesc: Supports a local process (stdio) or HTTP.

skills.deleteFailed: Could not delete. Please try again.
skills.emptyHint: Create one or import a folder to see it here
skills.dialogDesc: Written to FastVibe’s global skills directory and loaded by new sessions.
skills.name: Name

skills.instructionsPlaceholder: Full steps, commands and caveats. Relative paths are relative to the skill directory.

extensions.introAfter: . After install, its commands, tools and status appear in the chat.
extensions.emptyDesc: Switch to Marketplace to browse and install
extensions.noneDesc: Try a different keyword or type

import.scanFailed: Could not read other agents’ data directories
import.title: Import from other agents
import.desc: Read sessions from other coding agents on this machine, convert them and copy them into FastVibe. The originals are opened read-only and are never modified or deleted.
import.emptyDesc: No data directories for pi, Claude Code, Codex, opencode or zcode were found on this machine
import.listFailed: Could not read the session list
import.pickHint: Choose sessions to import. They will appear in the sidebar; the originals are left untouched.
import.onlyArchived: Only archived sessions remain — turn on “Show archived” to see them

remote.intro: Expose the agent running on this computer to another device over the web — a phone, a tablet, or a browser on another computer.
remote.setupDesc: Set a password. Other devices log in with it to connect. The password is kept only on this computer.
remote.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
remote.enableDesc: When on, other devices can log in with the password and connect to the agent on this computer.
remote.tunnelHint: {{address}} is only this computer's listening address, and no other device can reach it. Pick a tunnel below and the app will publish it for you — or point any tunnel tool of your own at that address.
remote.tunnelProviderDesc: The app starts it on this computer and shows the public address it returns.
remote.tunnelIdle: The tunnel starts with the server once "Allow remote connections" above is on.
remote.tunnelScan: Scan it with a phone camera, then log in with the password set above. The address changes every time the tunnel restarts.
remote.tunnelNeedsAuthDesc: {{name}} needs an authtoken from a free account before it will open a tunnel. Run the command below once with your own token in place of <token>, then come back and press "Authenticated".
remote.tunnelSetupCloudflared: Cloudflare Tunnel is free and needs no account. Install the cloudflared command, then come back and press "Installed".
remote.tunnelSetupNgrok: ngrok needs a free account: after installing the command, run it once with your own authtoken, or starting it fails on authentication.
remote.clientsDesc: Devices currently logged in and connected.
remote.noDevices: No device has logged in yet.
remote.changePasswordDesc: Changing the password signs every device out.
remote.changePasswordWarning: Setting a new password signs every logged-in device out; they will need it to log back in.
remote.turnOffDesc: Stops the server and clears the password. Every logged-in device is signed out.
remote.localOnly: Remote access is managed on the computer itself

remoteHosts.intro: Connect to a FastVibe Agent on another Linux machine over SSH — the connection is made from the Add project dialog. Hosts are read from ~/.ssh/config by default, and the icon here checks whether a login works on its own.
remoteHosts.dialogDesc: Configure the SSH connection and remote Agent access details.
remoteHosts.label: Name
remoteHosts.labelHint: Used to identify this machine in the host list.
remoteHosts.hostPlaceholder: e.g. dev.example.com or an alias from ~/.ssh/config
remoteHosts.hostHint: Enter a domain, IP address, or a Host alias from your SSH config.
remoteHosts.servicePortHint: The port FastVibe Agent listens on at the remote host. Leave empty to let the remote OS pick a free one.
remoteHosts.authMethodHint: Without a private key, the system default key or SSH agent is used.
remoteHosts.identityFileHint: Choose a private key on this computer; otherwise the default key / SSH agent is used.
remoteHosts.agentInstalled: Agent {{version}} is installed but not running
remoteHosts.stopAgentFailed: Could not stop the remote Agent
remoteHosts.invalidPort: Ports must be whole numbers between 1 and 65535
remoteHosts.localOnly: SSH hosts can only be managed on this computer
remoteHosts.localOnlyDesc: A remote client cannot edit or start SSH tunnels on this machine.

computer.accessibilityDesc: Lets FastVibe read window contents and click and type for you
computer.screenRecordingDesc: Lets FastVibe capture the screen, so it can see what is on it
computer.unavailable: No computer-control engine is available for this OS or architecture
computer.windowsNote: Windows needs no extra permission — computer control can be switched on directly.
computer.linuxNote: Linux needs no extra permission; support under Wayland depends on the compositor.
computer.remoteOnly: Computer-control permissions and switches can only be viewed and changed in FastVibe on that machine.
computer.enableDesc: Let FastVibe control other applications on your computer
computer.backgroundDesc: Does not take focus, so you can carry on working; a target that cannot accept it reports an error instead of grabbing focus anyway
computer.clipboardDesc: The clipboard is shared by every application, and writing replaces what you had on it
computer.allowedDesc: Actions in these applications are not confirmed each time. Everything else still asks, per the current permission mode.
computer.grantHint: Press Start granting once and FastVibe walks you through it: Screen Recording first — its settings page opens with a floating panel, which you drag into the list — and once the grant is detected, Accessibility opens by itself for the same gesture.
computer.flowHint: The panel is floating above System Settings. Drag it into the list for this step; the next one opens by itself. Esc cancels.

browser.useSystemDesc: browser-use drives an installed browser over its debugging port instead of the side-pane browser. It opens its own window and profile, and leaves the browser you are using alone.
browser.engineDesc: Which installed browser runs the tools. Automatic uses the first one found, in order: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium.
browser.importTitle: Import from a browser on this machine
browser.importDesc: Copy another browser's cookies and login state into the built-in browser. The source browser is not changed, and passwords are never read.
browser.importDescSystem: Copies into the browser chosen above. The window FastVibe opened is closed first, then written. The source browser is not changed, and passwords are never read.
browser.noProfilesDesc: Looks for the default and named profiles of Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, Arc and Opera.
browser.remote: Import only works on this machine
browser.remoteDesc: Import reads the browsers on the computer running the server, which a remote client cannot do.
